Welcome to 12 Lincoln Road located in the appealing Lake Hill Farms community. Conveniently located just minutes from the Town of Monroe. 12 Lincoln is situated on over half an acre of lushly landscaped, level & fenced property.  
Beautifully renovated inside and out! 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, large eat in kitchen, formal living room and family room with fireplace, fabulous in-ground pool! New tiled and granite kitchen, beautiful back splash, cabinets, new siding, windows, roof, heating system practically everything has been updated in a very tastefully in a neutral decor.  This home offers municipal water, sewer & natural gas. Monroe Woodbury school district, Monroe amenities  and nearby commuter facilities. Orange County boasts many fun filled activities.
